confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Prague pricing, not from inspected listings or menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable; accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by district and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine_glass were set by reference to the beer anchor and local price relationships because direct knowledge is weaker. Prices are bounded to the July 2026 window and may drift with inflation and exchange rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional knowledge of central European capitals with heavy tourism demand (for example Vienna, Budapest and Kraków), adjusted to Prague's own price levels in summer. Drinks were anchored to the beer price, with cocktails and wine priced at a premium and a discount to beer respectively, reflecting typical Czech restaurant and bar margins.
